note: SMS Phone Number extends phone_number with SMS verification + TFA. It defines an 'sms_phone_number' field type (subclass of PhoneNumberItem) adding field settings verify (none/optional/required) and message, and tracking a verified status. Global config object sms_phone_number.settings has tfa_field (user phone field for TFA) and verification_secret. Permission 'bypass phone number verification requirement'. SMS is sent via a callback (default SMS Framework sms_send), overridable with hook_sms_phone_number_send_sms_callback_alter. Actual SMS delivery needs an external gateway, so cases are grounded ONLY in local config: creating an sms_phone_number field with a verify setting, and the sms_phone_number.settings.tfa_field value; no case sends a real SMS. Fields are namespaced field_spn_* and each reset/cleanup deletes only its own field storage+instance. sms_phone_number.settings baseline: absent/empty (reset/cleanup restore that).

evals.prompt: What does the sms_phone_number submodule add on top of the phone_number field, and which field setting controls whether a number must be verified?
evals.expected_output: It adds an sms_phone_number field type (extending phone_number) with SMS verification and a verified status, plus SMS two-factor authentication (a TFA plugin). The field setting 'verify' controls verification and takes none / optional / required.

evals.prompt: How does sms_phone_number actually send a verification code by SMS, and how can I make it use my own SMS provider?
evals.expected_output: It sends through an SMS callback that defaults to SMS Framework's sms_send when installed. You override it by implementing hook_sms_phone_number_send_sms_callback_alter(&$send_sms_callback) to point at your own callback (which receives the international number and message). Without a gateway, no code can be delivered (check isSmsEnabled()).

evals.prompt: Where does sms_phone_number store its global settings for two-factor auth, and what permission lets someone save a number that hasn't been verified?
evals.expected_output: Global settings live in the config object sms_phone_number.settings (tfa_field = the user phone field used for TFA; verification_secret). The permission 'bypass phone number verification requirement' allows saving an unverified number even when verify is required.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has an sms_phone_number field named field_spn_known. Does it require the phone number to be SMS-verified? Inspect the live field configuration and give the value of the verify setting.
evals.expected_output: field_spn_known (type sms_phone_number) on node.article has field setting verify = 'required', so the number must be SMS-verified.

evals.prompt: Which user phone field is sms_phone_number configured to use for SMS two-factor authentication on this site? Inspect the live configuration and give the value.
On this site, add an sms_phone_number field named field_spn_task to the Article content type, configured so the phone number MUST be SMS-verified (verify = required). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a FieldStorageConfig field_spn_task on node of type 'sms_phone_number' and a FieldConfig on article with settings verify = 'required'. Verified by node.article having field_spn_task of type sms_phone_number with verify == required.

evals.prompt: I want SMS two-factor login to use the mobile phone field 'field_spn_mobile' on user accounts. Configure the sms_phone_number module to use that field for two-factor auth, on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set sms_phone_number.settings:tfa_field to 'field_spn_mobile' (drush cset sms_phone_number.settings tfa_field field_spn_mobile, or via sms_phone_number.util->setTfaField('field_spn_mobile')).
